title: Snopes.com: Chipotle $100 Gift Card Giveaway
description: Read our story: https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/chipotle-gift-card-giveaway/  Chipotle is not offering free $100 gift cards for National Avocado Day to internet users who share a link with their friends.

asr.full_text: A lot of people excited about this in honor of National Avocado Day, Chipotle offering free guacamole. Normally guac is an additional charge, but today you can get free guac if you use the offer code avocado. You do have to place your order online or use Chipotle's app. Yeah, we discussed it earlier whispering avocado to the people behind the counter probably isn't going to work. So don't be that person like I probably will be.

textual.observation: The source references a purported $100 Chipotle gift-card giveaway connected to internet users sharing a link with friends; the description explicitly denies that Chipotle is offering it.

evidence.quote: Chipotle is not offering free $100 gift cards for National Avocado Day to internet users who share a link with their friends.

textual.potential_relevance: A promised gift-card reward is linked to sharing a link with friends, creating a reward-for-action relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish who created the offer, whether any link or gift card was genuine, or whether anyone received or lost anything.

visual_context_notes.observation: Captions state that Chipotle launched a real guacamole giveaway for National Avocado Day, and a quoted on-screen offer says to use code "AVOCADO" with an online or in-app order for free guacamole or a free side of guacamole with specified purchases.
News footage labeled "Courtesy: WTKR News 3" and dated 31 July 2018 visibly describes free guacamole at Chipotle using the offer code "AVOCADO."

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it reports that Chipotle was not offering the purported $100 gift cards in exchange for sharing a link, and discusses the gift-card graphic, survey, and possible costly sign-up as a scam pattern. It also distinguishes that purported offer from a genuine guacamole promotion requiring an online or in-app order and the code AVOCADO.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content examines and warns about a purported gift-card giveaway, explicitly denying that Chipotle offers the described reward for sharing a link. The depicted third-party offer is not presented as a solicitation by the video.
